# Found First

> Founder-led AI marketing: answer engine optimization and ChatGPT advertising.

Contact: nick@modernapexstrategies.com

## Research library
- [Answer engine optimization services](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/answer-engine-optimization/): What an answer engine optimization (AEO) service does, what Google and OpenAI say a site needs, how results are measured and what it costs.
- [Getting recommended by ChatGPT](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): What gives ChatGPT a reason to name a business: crawler access, pages that answer real questions, consistent facts and public evidence. Plus how to check.
- [Google AI Overviews and AI Mode](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/google-ai-overviews/): What Google says a page needs to appear in AI Overviews and AI Mode: indexed, snippet-eligible, no special markup. And how Search Console counts it.
- [AEO content strategy](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-content-strategy/): How to plan content for AI answers: find buyers' real questions by buying stage, give each one a single page, back it with evidence and keep it current.
- [AEO vs. SEO vs. GEO](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-vs-seo-vs-geo/): SEO, AEO and GEO compared: what each term means, the work they share, what you measure differently, and why the label matters less than the work.
- [ChatGPT ads vs. Google Ads](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-ads-vs-google-ads/): ChatGPT ads and Google Search ads compared side by side: what triggers each ad, where it shows, how you pay, budgets, targeting and measurement.
- [ChatGPT advertising costs](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-advertising-cost/): What a ChatGPT ads budget pays for: media billed by OpenAI from $25 a day, management, the landing page, measurement and the test period.
- [ChatGPT ads management](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/chatgpt-ads-agency/): What managing ChatGPT ads involves, from eligibility and account setup to ad review, landing pages and reporting, and what stays with the advertiser.
- [AI visibility audits](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-visibility-audit/): What an AI visibility audit should check and hand over: the question set, saved answers with dates and models, sources, business facts and a ranked list.
- [Measuring AI marketing results](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/measure-ai-marketing-roi/): How to measure AI marketing: mentions, citations, visits, inquiries and revenue as separate measures, where each one is visible and what it cannot prove.
- [Choosing an AEO agency](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/choose-aeo-agency/): Questions to ask an AEO agency before you sign, what a good answer sounds like, and the red flags: guarantees, secret methods and no saved evidence.
- [AEO for local businesses](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-local-businesses/): What is different about AEO for a local business: the questions customers ask, the listing facts to confirm, and what our plumbing study does and does not show.
- [AEO for multi-location brands](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-multi-location-brands/): AEO for brands with many locations: which facts the brand sets and which each location owns, what a location page needs, and how to measure by location.
- [AEO for professional services](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/aeo-for-professional-services/): AEO for law, accounting, medical and consulting firms: evidence a client can check, named credentials, scope fit, and the conduct rules to check first.
- [AEO for B2B and SaaS](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-marketing-for-b2b-saas/): AEO for B2B software: the pages each buyer role needs, public pricing and docs, fair comparisons, and what a demo request can and cannot be attributed to.
- [AEO for ecommerce brands](https://befoundfirst.ai/learn/ai-marketing-for-ecommerce/): AEO for ecommerce: the product facts shoppers ask AI about, a product page audit, how pages, feeds and ads differ on Google and ChatGPT, and what to measure.

This file is a reading aid, not a requirement for AI search visibility.

## Original research
- [Research and insights](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/): Selected findings and interpretation.
- [Rooter-Man Austin study](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/rooter-man-austin/): A dated 240-answer baseline, with search cohorts and limitations.
- [Mentions, sources and recommendations](https://befoundfirst.ai/research/mentions-sources-recommendations/): How to interpret different evidence channels.
